description: This file defines the KuraAdapterProperties class, which extends MqttProtocolAdapterProperties to configure properties specific to the Kura MQTT adapter, including control prefix and content types for control and data messages.

classes.name: KuraAdapterProperties
classes.description: A class that extends MqttProtocolAdapterProperties to specify configuration properties for the Kura adapter, such as control prefixes and content types for control and data messages.

methods.name: getControlPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves the prefix used to identify control messages from a Kura gateway.

methods.name: setControlPrefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix used to identify control messages from a Kura gateway.

methods.name: getCtrlMsgContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type used for Kura control messages.

methods.name: setCtrlMsgContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type used for Kura control messages.

methods.name: getDataMsgContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type used for Kura data messages.

methods.name: setDataMsgContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type used for Kura data messages.
